title: Canonical Featured discovery visual acceptance

scope.subject: Align existing Playwright visual Places acceptance with canonical Featured section membership after removing UI-specific featured destination kinds and IDs

research_summary: The hosted visual suite already reuses Playwright and the repository's Places surface. Canonical discovery productization intentionally removes the fake featured destination kind/id while preserving the visible Featured section and data-destination-featured metadata. The only failing release visual case still selects .kind-featured, so reuse the existing Playwright visual harness and assert the real Featured group plus canonical row metadata instead of restoring an identity-only presentation kind.

sources.finding: Playwright recommends user-facing or stable semantic locators; the existing Featured group aria-label and explicit destination metadata are more faithful than a removed presentation-only kind class.
Existing retrying locator assertions are sufficient to validate that the Featured Places group is rendered and contains canonical featured destinations.

search_ladder.conclusion: Keep the current YEIS-backed Personal Universe Places product and canonical destination model; no separate visual product is needed.
Keep Playwright Test as the browser lifecycle and visual/retrying assertion framework.
Keep the existing hosted sharded release acceptance topology rather than creating a discovery-only CI lane.
Reuse the existing visualCase and Places screenshot case, changing only its stale Featured locator contract.

candidates.name: Existing Playwright Places visual acceptance
candidates.reason: Already captures the real Places product in the hosted release matrix; only the stale .kind-featured locator conflicts with canonical identity.

candidates.name: Restore a featured destination kind only for visual acceptance
candidates.reason: Would reintroduce the exact identity/presentation drift Agent 07 requires removing and make Search/Places disagree again.

coverage_matrix.capability: Places visual smoke proves the Featured section is visible without minting alternate destination identity
coverage_matrix.decision: Locate the Featured group by its existing aria-label and assert a row with data-destination-featured=true.

coverage_matrix.capability: Hosted desktop visual capture remains in the same release suite
coverage_matrix.decision: Do not create a second screenshot framework or discovery-only visual lane.

decision.rationale: Update only the stale visual locator so the existing hosted visual case measures the canonical Featured presentation contract. Do not weaken screenshot/readiness checks and do not reintroduce fake featured identities.
decision.fallback: If the semantic Featured group becomes inaccessible, fix the product's accessible section labelling rather than selecting implementation-only CSS or restoring a fake destination kind.
